title: MyLinden Help: Paying Ahead, Payoff Statements and Balance Reductions on Patient Payment Plans
content:
On a Patient Payment Plans plan, an extra payment and a reduction of an enrolled charge are each absorbed in one of two ways, fixed by the tier; a payoff statement is issued within a fixed number of business days.

**How is an extra payment applied, and how is a reduction absorbed?**

| Tier | Extra payment applied by | Insurance payment or adjustment on an enrolled charge absorbed by | Payoff statement issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | Shortening the term | Shortening the term | 2 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | Shortening the term | Shortening the term | 2 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | Shortening the term | Reducing the installment | 2 |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | Shortening the term | Reducing the installment | 2 |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | Shortening the term | Reducing the installment | 2 |
| Financial Hardship Plan | Reducing the installment | Reducing the installment | 2 |

**What do the two methods mean?**

- *Shortening the term*: the installment stays the same and the plan ends earlier.
- *Reducing the installment*: the end date stays the same and the installment is lowered.

**How soon is a payoff statement issued?** Within 2 business days of the request, on every tier.

**Which tier treats both events by reducing the installment?** Only the Financial Hardship Plan applies extra payments by reducing the installment; the 12-Month Interest-Free Plan and both Extended Plans reduce the installment only for reductions of enrolled charges.
